kodecraft is a full code editor and IDE that runs in your terminal. Open a project and get a mouse-aware editor with code intelligence, search, Git, database and REST clients, plus image and hex viewers, all in one terminal window.

Start it from the Start menu, or type kode, koders or kd in any terminal to open a folder or file.

UNDERSTANDS YOUR CODE WITHOUT ANY SETUP
Highlighting, completion, go to definition and find usages work straight away, across files and including your unsaved edits. No language server is required.
Deep analysis: Kotlin and C.
Syntax tree analysis: C++, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Swift, CSS, JSON, C#, D, Lua, Markdown, OCaml, Pascal, Perl, SQL, Svelte, YAML and Zig.
Pattern-based symbols: Java, Rust, Dart, PowerShell, R, MATLAB, Scala, Objective-C, Visual Basic, Groovy, Julia and Haskell.
Keyword highlighting: more than 200 other languages and file types.
For compiler-grade results, add a language server from Settings. rust-analyzer, gopls, clangd, Eclipse JDT LS and others are supported, and kodecraft falls back to its built-in analysis if a server is missing or fails.

A REAL EDITOR
Multiple cursors and selections, with Alt+click, Alt+drag or Ctrl+Shift+Up and Down. Turn every search match into a cursor with Alt+Enter. Word-by-word navigation, folding, a minimap, undo and redo, and full mouse support. The same editor is used everywhere, including SQL consoles, REST bodies and commit messages.

FIND ANYTHING
Press Ctrl+F to find and replace in the current window with regular expressions and capture groups. Press Alt+F to search every text file in the project and edit the results right inside the search dialog.

GIT
Stage and unstage changes, write commits, switch local branches, create tags and browse history. Read changes as side-by-side or unified diffs and restore a single chunk. Push, pull and fetch are not included; use the built-in shell shortcut, Ctrl+T, for those.

DATABASES
Connect to PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server, SQLite, H2 and many other databases with a JDBC driver. Browse schemas and tables, run statements or whole scripts, cancel long queries, and control commits from the console. Database connections need Java 21 or newer; everything else works without Java.

REST CLIENT
Import and export Postman collections and import OpenAPI definitions. Send HTTP, Server-Sent Events and WebSocket requests with API key, Bearer, Basic, Digest, OAuth 1.0, OAuth 2.0, Hawk, AWS Signature, NTLM or Akamai EdgeGrid authentication. Use environments, run whole folders and review past runs.

IMAGES AND BINARY FILES
View PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TGA, DDS, PSD and Krita images right in the terminal. Inspect binary files in a hex view with 8, 16 or 32 bytes per row, and find text or hex bytes. You can cut, copy, paste and delete bytes to experiment, but those edits stay in memory: binary files can't be saved yet, so your file on disk is never changed.

PICKS UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Open files, cursor positions, undo history and even unsaved changes survive a restart.
